title: Counting the Coverage Months Not Yet Billed on a Rider
content:
The coverage months not yet billed on one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders are counted differently according to what the rider premium account already carries and whether the rider record carries a day the rider ended.

## The rule

**Where a rider premium charge already stands on the rider premium account and the rider record carries no day the rider ended**, a whole cycle's worth of coverage months is taken once as long as a cycle has passed since the last charge was posted, and none before then.

**Where a rider premium charge already stands on the rider premium account and the rider record carries a day the rider ended**, the whole calendar months from the day the last charge was posted to the day the rider ended are taken.

**Otherwise**, the whole calendar months from the day the rider took effect to the handling date are taken, the month the rider took effect in counting as one of them.

## Condition and count

| The rider premium account | The rider record | The coverage months not yet billed |
|---|---|---|
| Carries at least one charge | Carries no day the rider ended, and a cycle has passed since the last charge was posted | A whole cycle's worth |
| Carries at least one charge | Carries no day the rider ended, and a cycle has not passed since the last charge was posted | None |
| Carries at least one charge | Carries a day the rider ended | The whole calendar months from the day the last charge was posted to that day |
| Carries no charge at all | Either | The whole calendar months from the day the rider took effect to the handling date, the month it took effect counting as one |

In every case the count is never fewer than none.

## Worked on hypothetical inputs

- **No charge yet standing, the rider having taken effect 4 whole calendar months before the handling date:** the count is 5, the month the rider took effect counting as one of them.
- **A charge standing, no day the rider ended, a billing cycle carrying 1 coverage month, the last charge posted 2 whole calendar months before the handling date:** a cycle has passed, so a whole cycle's worth is taken: 1.
- **The same, but the last charge posted in the month of handling:** a cycle has not passed, so none is taken.
- **A charge standing, the rider record carrying a day the rider ended 3 whole calendar months after the last charge was posted:** the count is 3.
